_comment: RATCHET BASELINE. Regenerate with: UPDATE_BASELINE=1 npx jest test/noUnnecessaryConditionRatchet.test.ts — never edit by hand to make a failure go away.

_why.summary: 18 of these entries are DELIBERATE guards, not accidents. Migration 20260828120000_diff_identity_is_its_capture_pair made UrlVersionDiff.beforeSnapshotId/afterSnapshotId NOT NULL, so the UNCHECKABLE / unlinkedDiffs / refusedDiffIds branches in the diff-readers became branches the TYPES say can never run.
_why.why_kept: The type is enforced by a constraint that ships with this code but is NOT YET APPLIED, and forensics:rediff / forensics:measure-divergence run locally against real environments OUTSIDE the deploy ordering that guarantees migrations land first. Between merge and migration the runtime can produce what the type calls impossible. Deleting a guard because a linter argues from a type that does not yet describe reality is the extractHrefs near-miss, recorded in the plan.
_why.condition_to_drop: When 20260828120000 is applied in EVERY environment — check the _prisma_migrations ledger on production, not the deploy status — set these files' entries to 0. The ratchet then reports a REGRESSION until the dead branches are actually removed, which turns 'delete them later' from an intention into a condition.
_why.note: evidenceRoutes carries 6 in total; only 2 of them come from that migration. The rest of this baseline is pre-existing debt that predates Level 5 and is bounded here rather than endorsed.
